name: Full Stack Web Development (JavaScript)
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project

beginner.summary: For new developers and career changers. Covers how the web works, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, Git, building REST APIs with Node.js and Express, storing data in MongoDB and PostgreSQL, React front ends, authentication, connecting front end to back end and deploying a full application.
prerequisites: Comfortable using a computer and the internet
Basic logical thinking; no programming experience required
Can install software on their machine
outcomes: Build responsive web pages with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Build REST APIs with Node.js, Express and a database
Build React front ends that call those APIs
Add authentication and deploy a complete web application

days.topic: How the Web Works and Developer Setup
subtopics: Front end, back end and databases
Installing VS Code, Node.js and Git
days.lab_task: Set up the development environment, inspect the requests a real website makes in DevTools, and draw how a login request travels from browser to database and back.
days.deliverable: Working environment and request flow diagram
checks: Browser, server and database steps labelled

subtopics: Semantic elements: header, nav, main, footer
Accessibility basics: alt text and labels
days.lab_task: Build a multi-page site for a local business with semantic HTML, a contact form with labels and a product table, and validate every page.
checks: Use the form with the keyboard

days.topic: CSS Styling and Layout with Flexbox and Grid
days.lab_task: Style the business site with a responsive navigation bar, a Flexbox product grid that becomes one column on phones and a Grid page layout.
checks: Layout fits with no horizontal scroll
objectives: Lay out pages with Flexbox and Grid

days.lab_task: Write JavaScript functions to calculate cart totals with discounts and tax, validate an email, and filter a list of products by price, testing each in the console.
checks: Calculate a total with a 10 percent discount

days.lab_task: Build an interactive to-do list with add, complete and delete, filtering by status and saving to localStorage, using plain JavaScript and the DOM.
checks: One listener handles all delete buttons

subtopics: The event loop in simple terms
days.lab_task: Build a weather page that calls a public API with fetch and async/await, shows loading and error states and displays a five-day forecast.
checks: Search a city that does not exist

days.lab_task: Put the projects on GitHub, build a feature on a branch, open a pull request, resolve a merge conflict and merge it.
days.deliverable: GitHub repositories and merged pull request
checks: Clear commits on main and the feature branch
Merge completed with both changes kept

days.lab_task: Write a Node.js script that reads a CSV of products and writes JSON, then a basic HTTP server that returns the products, with settings from environment variables.
checks: JSON file created with all products
Change the port with an environment variable
Server listens on the new port

days.lab_task: Build a products REST API with Express supporting list, get, create, update and delete, with validation, correct status codes and central error handling.
checks: Create a product without a name
Get a product that does not exist

days.lab_task: Store the products API data in MongoDB with Mongoose schemas, validation and a reference from orders to products, and query them in Compass.
days.deliverable: API with MongoDB and Compass screenshots
checks: Create a product with a negative price
Create an order and populate products

days.lab_task: Build the same orders API on PostgreSQL with Prisma, create migrations, join orders with customers and compare the design with the MongoDB version.
days.deliverable: Prisma schema, migrations, API and comparison

days.lab_task: Build a React front end for the shop that lists products from the API, shows details and lets users add items to a cart.
Add routes for products, product detail, cart and checkout, and a checkout form that posts an order to the API and shows validation errors.

days.topic: Connecting Front End and Back End
subtopics: File structure for full stack projects
days.lab_task: Connect the React app and the Express API with proper CORS, a typed API client, pagination for products and consistent error handling.
checks: Call the API from another origin not allowed
Same error display on every page
objectives: Connect front end and back end

days.lab_task: Add sign-up, login and logout with hashed passwords and HTTP-only cookie tokens, protect order routes in the API and the account page in React.
checks: Call the orders API without logging in

subtopics: Unit tests with Vitest or Jest
End-to-end tests with Playwright in brief
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for cart logic, API tests for products and orders, component tests for checkout and one Playwright test for the purchase flow.
checks: All pass against a test database
objectives: Test front end and back end

days.topic: File Uploads, Email and Third-Party Services
subtopics: Payment gateway basics with test mode
days.lab_task: Add product image uploads to cloud storage, an order confirmation email and a test-mode payment with a webhook that marks orders paid.
checks: Image stored and shown on the product

days.lab_task: Find and fix five planted vulnerabilities in the shop, add security headers and rate limiting to login and run a dependency audit.

subtopics: Hosting the API: Render, Railway or a VM
tools: MongoDB Atlas or a managed PostgreSQL
days.lab_task: Deploy the React front end and Express API with a managed database and HTTPS, configure production environment variables and set up automatic deploys from GitHub.
checks: Products load from the live API
Valid certificate on both front end and API

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Full Stack Online Store
days.lab_task: Build and deploy an online store with product browsing, search, cart, sign-up and login, checkout with test payments, order history, tests and security checks, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URLs, test report and a 10-minute demo
checks: Complete a purchase on the live site
Call an order API as another user
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one application
Build and deploy a full stack app

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built a basic full stack app. Covers TypeScript across the stack, Next.js full stack apps, API design, advanced data modelling, background jobs, caching, real-time features, containers, CI/CD, cloud deployment, observability, testing strategy and performance.
prerequisites: Has built a React front end and a Node.js API with a database
outcomes: Build typed full stack apps with Next.js or React and Node.js
Design APIs and data models for real products
Add jobs, caching and real-time features
Ship with containers, CI/CD, monitoring and tests

subtopics: Shared types between front end and back end
days.lab_task: Convert the store to TypeScript in a monorepo with a shared types package and Zod schemas used by both API and front end.
checks: Both apps show compile errors until updated
Send invalid data to the API
Rejected by the shared Zod schema

days.topic: API Design: REST, Versioning and Documentation
days.lab_task: Redesign the store API with consistent resources, cursor pagination, a standard error format, idempotent order creation and OpenAPI documentation.
checks: Create an order twice with one idempotency key

days.lab_task: Rebuild the store's catalogue and account area in Next.js with server components, server actions and Auth.js, using Prisma for data.
checks: Add to cart with a server action
Page shows the change after revalidation
objectives: Build full stack apps with Next.js

subtopics: Modelling users, products, orders and payments
days.lab_task: Design the data model for a multi-vendor marketplace, add constraints and indexes, place an order in a transaction that updates stock and seed realistic data.
days.deliverable: Schema, migrations, seed script and query timings
checks: Order the last item from two sessions
Use indexes and run in under 50 ms

days.lab_task: Move order emails and invoice PDFs to background jobs with retries, schedule a nightly sales report and monitor the queue.
checks: Make the email service fail twice

days.lab_task: Add Redis caching for product lists, HTTP caching for images and CDN caching for static assets, invalidate on updates and load-test before and after.
days.deliverable: Caching set-up and load test results

days.lab_task: Add live order status updates and a buyer-seller chat with authenticated sockets, scaled across two server instances with the Redis adapter.
checks: Connect to a different server instance

days.topic: OAuth, Social Login and Role-Based Access
subtopics: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect in practice
Social login with Google and GitHub
Showing permitted actions in the UI
days.lab_task: Add Google and GitHub login, refresh-token renewal and roles for buyer, vendor and admin, enforce permissions in the API and log every admin action.
days.deliverable: Auth set-up, permission tests and audit log
checks: Call a vendor-only endpoint as a buyer
Action recorded in the audit log

days.topic: GraphQL APIs for Full Stack Apps
subtopics: Generated types for the front end
days.lab_task: Add a GraphQL API for the catalogue with data loaders, authorisation on vendor fields, query depth limits and generated types used in the React front end.
days.deliverable: GraphQL server, client changes and tests
checks: One vendor query thanks to the data loader
Query vendor revenue as a buyer

subtopics: Full-text search in PostgreSQL or MongoDB
days.lab_task: Add product search with typo tolerance, facets for category and price and an indexing pipeline that updates search when products change.
checks: Search reflects the change within seconds

days.topic: Containers with Docker and Docker Compose
subtopics: Docker Compose for the full stack
days.lab_task: Containerise the front end, API, worker, database and Redis, run the whole stack with Docker Compose and cut image sizes with multi-stage builds.
days.deliverable: Dockerfiles, Compose file and image sizes

days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that lints, type-checks, tests with a database container, builds images, runs migrations and deploys to staging then production with approval.
checks: Migrations run and the app works

subtopics: Cloud options for full stack apps
AWS: ECS or App Runner, RDS and S3
Azure: App Service or Container Apps and Azure Database
days.lab_task: Deploy the containerised store to AWS or Azure with a managed database and Redis, HTTPS, secrets from a secret manager and autoscaling, and estimate monthly cost.
checks: No secrets in images or code

days.topic: Observability: Logging, Metrics and Error Tracking
days.lab_task: Add structured logs with request IDs, API metrics, a Grafana dashboard, Sentry for front end and back end, and an alert on error rate.
checks: All logs share the request ID
Appears in Sentry with source lines

days.topic: Testing Strategy for Full Stack Teams
subtopics: Mock Service Worker for the front end
Contract tests between front end and API
days.lab_task: Build a test suite with factories, API tests on a container database, front-end tests with MSW and end-to-end tests for three journeys, all running in CI.
objectives: Plan testing for full stack apps

days.lab_task: Implement an order state machine with stock reservation, payment webhooks, refunds and GST invoices, and reconcile orders with the payment provider.
days.deliverable: Order logic, webhook handler and reconciliation report
checks: Every paid order matches a provider payment

days.topic: Accessibility and SEO for Full Stack Apps
days.lab_task: Make product pages accessible and SEO-ready with server rendering, metadata, structured data and a sitemap, and reach high Lighthouse scores.
checks: Use a screen reader on checkout

days.lab_task: Test the store for broken object-level authorisation and other API risks, fix the findings, add security scans to CI and log security events.
checks: Read another user's order by ID
Upload a script disguised as an image

days.topic: Working in a Full Stack Team
days.lab_task: Work as a team on three tickets for the store with branches, code reviews, a feature flag and a design hand-off, and handle one simulated production bug.
days.deliverable: Merged pull requests, review comments and bug fix record
checks: Root cause found and a test added

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Typed Marketplace on the Cloud
subtopics: Typed API and Next.js front end
days.lab_task: Deliver a typed multi-vendor marketplace with search, payments, real-time order updates, background jobs, caching, tests, CI/CD to the cloud and monitoring, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL, dashboards, test reports and a 15-minute demo
checks: Tests pass and the app deploys
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product

advanced.summary: For senior full stack engineers and technical leads. Covers system design, monolith and microservice architecture, event-driven design, data at scale, multi-tenancy, performance and scalability, resilience, security architecture, platform and developer experience, observability at scale, cost, AI features and technical leadership.
prerequisites: Has shipped and run full stack applications in production
Knows TypeScript, Next.js or React, Node.js, SQL and containers
Has done code reviews and production support
outcomes: Design and scale full stack systems
Choose and evolve architecture from monolith to services
Engineer reliability, security and performance in production

days.lab_task: Design a ticket booking system for one million daily users with estimates, components, data flow and failure handling, and defend it in a design review.
days.deliverable: Design document, estimates and decision records
checks: Each component has a failure plan

days.lab_task: Restructure the marketplace into a modular monolith with enforced boundaries, extract payments into a service and coordinate orders with a saga.
days.deliverable: Restructured code, extracted service and saga
checks: Saga cancels the order and releases stock

days.lab_task: Publish order events with an outbox, consume them in inventory and email services idempotently, version a schema and trace one order through the events.
checks: Old and new consumers both work

days.topic: Data at Scale: Replication, Partitioning and Search
days.lab_task: Add read replicas, partition the orders table by month, run a zero-downtime column migration and restore the database to a point in time.
days.deliverable: Configuration, migration log and restore evidence
checks: Writes on primary, reads on replica
Restore to a point in time

days.lab_task: Turn the marketplace into a multi-tenant SaaS with row-level security, tenant-aware caching, subscription billing and automated onboarding.
days.deliverable: Multi-tenant app, billing set-up and isolation tests

days.topic: API Gateways, Backends for Frontends and Edge Architecture
subtopics: Rate limiting and authentication at the edge
days.lab_task: Put the services behind a gateway with authentication and rate limits, add a backend for frontend that aggregates three services for the product page and move geo-routing to the edge.
days.deliverable: Gateway configuration, BFF and latency measurements
checks: One BFF call replaces three browser calls

days.lab_task: Load-test the system to its limit, find and fix three bottlenecks across front end, API and database, and write a capacity plan for ten times the traffic.
days.deliverable: Load test reports, fixes and capacity plan
checks: Saturation point at least twice as high

days.lab_task: Add timeouts, retries and a circuit breaker around payments, degrade gracefully when search is down, define SLOs and run a chaos test.
days.deliverable: Resilience code, SLOs and chaos test report
checks: Requests fail fast and the UI explains
Catalogue still works with a basic list
SLO kept or the gap recorded

subtopics: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect at scale
days.lab_task: Threat-model the platform, move identity to an OIDC provider with service-to-service tokens, manage secrets in Vault and fix findings from a penetration test.
days.deliverable: Threat model, identity set-up and remediation record
checks: Call a service without a service token

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes for Full Stack Apps
days.lab_task: Define the infrastructure in Terraform, deploy the services to Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD, autoscale the API and compare with the managed platform used earlier.
days.deliverable: Terraform, Helm charts, GitOps set-up and comparison
checks: Change the Helm values in Git

days.lab_task: Trace a request from the browser through the API, queue and database, build SLO dashboards with burn-rate alerts and tune sampling to control cost.
days.deliverable: Tracing, dashboards, alerts and cost note
checks: Data volume reduced with errors still kept

days.lab_task: Build a golden path template that creates a new service with tests, CI, observability and deployment in minutes, and measure time to first deploy for a new developer.
checks: Create a service from the template
Project runs with no local set-up

days.lab_task: Analyse a month of platform costs, cut the top three costs, calculate cost per tenant and set budgets and alerts.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis, changes and cost per tenant report

days.topic: AI Features in Full Stack Products
days.lab_task: Add a shopping assistant that searches products with embeddings in pgvector, streams answers, adds items to the cart through tool calls with confirmation and is evaluated on 25 questions.
days.deliverable: AI feature, evaluation and cost note
checks: Relevant products returned from the vector search
Confirmation asked before the tool call

days.topic: Migrating and Modernising Legacy Web Applications
subtopics: Moving from PHP or old Node.js versions
days.lab_task: Route traffic for two pages of a provided legacy app to new React and Node.js implementations with the strangler pattern, migrate their data and measure progress.
days.deliverable: Routing set-up, migrated pages and progress report
checks: Served by the new app with the same behaviour
Still served by the old app
Share of traffic on new code measured

subtopics: Data protection laws: DPDP Act and GDPR
days.lab_task: Add consent tracking, data export and deletion requests, retention jobs and audit logs to the platform, and prepare compliance evidence.
checks: Personal data removed from all stores

days.topic: Technical Leadership for Full Stack Teams
days.lab_task: Write a technical vision for the platform, run a technical debt review that ranks items by impact, and mentor a junior developer through a code review.
days.deliverable: Vision, debt register and mentoring notes

days.topic: Hiring, Team Structure and Engineering Process
days.lab_task: Design a team structure and hiring loop for five product teams, write an onboarding plan and measure DORA metrics for a team from provided data.
days.deliverable: Team design, interview loop, onboarding plan and metrics
checks: Each stage tests a defined skill
First week tasks and goals clear

days.topic: Production Troubleshooting for Full Stack Systems
subtopics: Memory leaks and CPU spikes in Node.js
days.lab_task: Resolve four injected incidents (a database lock storm, a Node.js memory leak, a broken front-end release and a payment provider outage), lead the response and write runbooks.
checks: Database recovers and the cause is found
Write a runbook for provider outages

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Scalable Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
subtopics: Event-driven services and data at scale
days.lab_task: Deliver a multi-tenant SaaS platform with event-driven services, partitioned data, tenant isolation, billing, Kubernetes deployment, SLO monitoring, an AI assistant and privacy features, then load-test and present it.
days.deliverable: Repositories, deployment, dashboards, load test report and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Architecture and cost defended with data
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
